No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The diamond retains a leafless tree with four selected branches, one ground/water line and a separate fish with tail, lower fin and X eye. The fish and X are independently enlarged and placed lower than the context line so each X stroke is at least 12.7 mm. The fin remains attached at calculated ellipse points. This taught symbol is not evidence of an actual ecological condition, pollutant or death, nor a certified regulatory label.", "canvas_mm": [170, 170]}, "teaching": "The diamond retains a leafless tree with four selected branches, one ground/water line and a separate fish with tail, lower fin and X eye. This taught symbol is not evidence of an actual ecological condition, pollutant or death, nor a certified regulatory label.
